peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: The first demonstration of the Logic Theorist (LT) written by Allen Newell, Cliff Shaw and Herbert A. Simon (Carnegie Institute of Technology, now Carnegie Mellon University or CMU). This is often called the first AI program, though Samuel's checkers program also has a strong claim.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What was the first AI program developed in 1956?
